title: Household Length: Shipping a New Tailwise Pharmacy Diet Order on the Household's Rhythm
content:
*Autoship and pharmacy coordination note.*

On a new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription diet order whose diet another pet of the customer already takes in the same package — the household prescription — the days' supply per fill follows how the household's supply runs: the household length. It is read from the household prescription's status, the renewal requests recorded against it, its dispensed fills, and the Tailwise Autoship subscriptions of the household pet.

**Household refill interval.** The calendar days from the household prescription's first dispensed fill to its most recent dispensed fill, divided by its dispensed fills less one, rounded down to a whole day; where it has fewer than two dispensed fills, its days' supply per fill.

## Rule

| Household prescription | Household pet's Autoship Pharmacy subscription for the same item | Household length |
|---|---|---|
| active, or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer | one in status active or pending first shipment | that subscription's frequency in weeks multiplied by 7 days |
| active, or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer | none in either of those statuses | the household refill interval |
| neither active nor carrying such a request | any | 30 days |

The same item is the same package item number; the subscription is the household pet's, as the Tailwise Autoship records show it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- Household prescription active; household pet's Autoship Pharmacy subscription for the diet active every 6 weeks: 42 days.
- Household prescription expired, with a renewal request against it awaiting the veterinarian's answer; the household pet's subscription is paused; fills on 2026-01-04, 2026-02-21 and 2026-04-10: 96 days divided by 2, 48 days.
- Household prescription refills exhausted, no renewal request awaiting an answer: 30 days.
